parole.significato: A North Caucasian highlander, a guerrilla fighter during Russian expansion in the North Caucasus in the 19th century.
parole.testo: From Ossetian абырӕг (abyræg, “robber”) via Russian абре́к (abrɛ́k).

parole.significato: Of or pertaining to the Iron people.
parole.testo: From Ossetian Ирон (Iron), a derivation (with the adjective suffix Ossetian -он (-on) from the historical genitive plural Proto-Indo-Iranian *-ānaHam) of Ossetian Ир (Ir).
